Ayini Boutique

Making local craftsmanship easier to discover.

Bridal blouses, aari work and custom outfits deserve clear service information as well as beautiful photographs. We shaped Ayini’s search foundations around its work in Thanjavur, then mapped the next phase for discovery through AI answers.

Two service pages
Focused on local enquiries

Next phase
GEO & AEO strategy

Give each service a clear place.

Ayini’s services needed to be easy to understand on their own terms. A customer looking for a bridal blouse in Thanjavur has a specific question. We gave those intentions dedicated pages, each with a clear service and local focus.

The completed SEO work included a clearer homepage search position and two local service pages: bridal blouses and customised dresses. The language ties the service to the place, helping visitors understand what Ayini offers and where to begin.

Build the foundation around real information.

Service-led pages
Dedicated pages for bridal blouse and customised dress enquiries in Thanjavur, with a clearer route from the main navigation.
Collections and navigation
More useful collection descriptions and metadata, cleaner menu links, and a corrected co-ord collection URL with a redirect.
Supporting content
Two blog posts to add context around the services and create additional paths into the website.
Search and local presence
Search Console verification, sitemap submission and indexing requests, together with updates to the Google Business Profile and service information.

Make the next question easy to answer.

Search visibility is part of a customer journey. The page should explain the service clearly, connect it with relevant collections, and make the next step easy to find. That is why the work covers navigation, content and local business information together.

The finished foundation gives Ayini focused service pages and a clearer structure for ongoing search work. Future content can connect directly with the relevant services and collections through useful internal links.

Next: a clearer presence in AI answers.

The later GEO and AEO work is an AI-discovery roadmap. Its focus is practical: clear answers to buying questions, accurate order and fit information, understandable service descriptions, and consistent business details.

The roadmap also covers crawl access, canonical URLs, sitemaps, internal links, existing structured data and the separate checks needed for ChatGPT Search access. It sets out a baseline for mentions, citations and referral visits, so the next phase can be assessed against consistent evidence.

A stronger base for the work to be found.

Ayini’s completed SEO scope brings the brand’s local services into clearer focus: two dedicated service pages, supporting articles, cleaner collection information and a connected local search presence. The next step builds on that same clarity for customers asking questions through AI search.
